decisions.subject: NB54361-L
decisions.summary: NB54361-L rejected as substitute for NB54360 on PSM-28 Rev 2
decisions.reason: Fails thermal derating at 70C ambient in sealed avionics enclosures (TR-112)

evidence.quote: we reject NB54361-L as a substitute for NB54360 on PSM-28 Rev 2 because it fails thermal derating at 70C ambient in sealed avionics enclosures (TR-112)
NB54361-L on PSM-28 Rev 2 went into thermal shutdown at 68C ambient under full load in the sealed enclosure.
